annotations.title: Suggest a brand or correct a listing

description: Suggest a brand (add_brand) or correct a listing (correct_listing). A public source_url (http or https) is required. Every submission goes to a human review queue; nothing is published automatically. We don't act on individual agent experiences; a listing only changes once it is verified from official docs, a brand statement, reputable reporting, or our own documented test. Do not include personal data about the user.

contact.description: Optional. Stored separately, used only to follow up on this submission, never published. Privacy policy: https://agentsallowed.io/privacy/

details.description: What should change, and why the source supports it.

domain.description: Domain or URL the update is about.

source_url.description: Required. Public http or https link to a brand statement, official docs or reputable article.
